name: Muted Isometric Infographic
description: Clean thirty-degree isometric objects and buildings in soft teal, sand and slate, arranged as a tidy modular diagram on a plain light ground with gentle soft shadows.
style_bible: A flat isometric explanatory illustration: objects arranged in a tidy modular diagram rather than a scene. Projection: true thirty-degree axonometric — every vertical stays vertical, the two ground axes rise at thirty degrees, and there is no perspective convergence, no vanishing point and no lens look. Forms: simple extruded blocks and simple solids with crisp clean edges, built from a few straight planes and simple curves; detail is reduced to what identifies the object, and nothing is modelled with micro-texture. Palette: soft teal, sand, slate and warm grey, muted and close in value so the arrangement reads as one calm diagram rather than a set of competing objects. Shading: gentle soft shadow pooled beneath each object and one soft tone on a single side plane; surfaces themselves stay flat, with no gradient running across a face, no specular highlight and no reflective gloss. Composition: objects spaced evenly on a plain light neutral background, aligned to the isometric grid, arranged with deliberate modular order and clear groupings; explanatory and calm, precise but friendly. Keep the contract content-independent and free of labels: no lettering, no numbers, no captions, no icons that carry words.
